live_default.reason: The camera-conditioned painting posterior is implemented, and frozen body/material posteriors now initialize motor-forecast joint state and the four independent paint fields. Belief-derived substrate-grain/brush/contact/model forecast construction and the executed-action transition-prior/camera-update schedule remain incomplete. Policy inference, learning, and oracle bootstrap remain fail closed instead of reading process truth.

classifications.physical_sensor_observation: A simulated value with a direct planned hardware sensor analogue. It is not necessarily assimilated by the current agent.
classifications.derived_observation: A deterministic or statistical transform of observations or process state. Derivation from hidden process truth does not make it sensor-equivalent.
classifications.hidden_state: A generative-process state or parameter that the physical agent cannot read directly.
classifications.simulator_only_evaluation_label: Process truth retained only for rendering, debugging, scoring, calibration assessment, or failure analysis.
classifications.execution_only_state: Commands, calibrated geometry, controller state, or hard-safety state below painting-policy selection.
